## Media Coverage

My research on experimental economics and charitable giving has been featured in various media outlets and has contributed to policy discussions. Below are selected media highlights:

### Featured Press Coverage

- **The Economist** - "*Behavioral Economics in Public Policy*" (February 2025)
  A discussion on how behavioral economics insights can improve policy implementation.

- **Financial Times** - "*New Research on Charitable Giving Patterns*" (November 2024)
  Coverage of our research on factors influencing high-net-worth donor decisions.

- **BBC Radio 4** - "*The Psychology of Giving*" (September 2024)
  Interview on research findings about motivational factors in charitable donation behavior.

### Public Policy Impact

My research has informed several policy initiatives:

- **UK Treasury Behavioral Insights Team** - Contributed research on tax incentives for charitable giving (2023-2025)
- **European Commission Report** - Expert input on "Philanthropic Capital and Social Innovation" (2024)
- **OECD Working Group** - Advisory role on behavioral economics applications in development aid (2022-present)
